thread:
maya chen: Heads-up: noticed churn in header-based routing when v2 rollout flips affinity for some long-lived sessions. Seeing tokenized clients get routed to v1 unexpectedly. Anyone else?
kevin park: Yep, saw a spike in 5xxs around 04:12; looks like affinity key `X-Client-ID` wasn't propagated in the proxy rewrite. Possibly related to the quota mapping logic.
olivia hsu: Can you paste a tiny sample from the proxy logs? want to confirm the header strip.
kevin park: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T04:12:11Z] proxy: rewrite: removed X-Client-ID
[2026-03-19T04:12:11Z] request: POST /v2/generate?model=redwood-large
[headers] Authorization: ***; User-Agent: sdk/0.9.1
```
raj singh: If `X-Client-ID` is missing we fallback to cookie-based affinity, which for older SDKs uses a different namespace => routed to v1. Two issues: proxy header strip + quota mapper has no alias for the new header name.
maya chen: Proposed short-term: update proxy to preserve `X-Client-ID` and add a mapping in quota service: `sdk-client-id` -> `x-client-id`. Long-term: console should surface sessions with mixed-model routing so support + customers can spot drift.
sylvia: Agree. Also need a telemetry signal `affinity_mismatch` and a dashboard tile showing percentage of requests that changed model between attempts. PM wants to expose that to enterprise tenants.
manu: For rollout UX, can we add a toggle in console to "enforce model affinity" that fails closed (rejects requests without affinity header) vs "soft reroute" (auto-fallthrough)?
olivia hsu: Soft reroute is useful for minimizing 4xx, but it makes billing/quotas messy. If we soft-reroute to v1, tokens may be billed to v1 pricing and quotas consumed unexpectedly for customers.
kevin park: We can tag routed requests with `X-Route-Reason: affinity-mismatch` and have the billing pipeline emit a reconciliation flag. That gives visibility without hard failing customers during canary.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: proxy-preserve-header patch -> canary on p-prod-1 at 1921007000 UTC. Rollback window 10m.
maya chen: I'll open a quick console PR to add telemetry metric `affinity_mismatch.v2` and a raw logs filter. Also drafting deprecation copy for v1 noting possible cross-routing during rollouts.
raj singh: One last ask: sample 0.1% of affected requests and store full request+response for quality evals so QA can replay across model variants.
olivia hsu: Sounds good. Can someone add the quota alias change to the next maintenance window? If not, I'll take it.
sylvia: :thumbsup: I'm good with this plan. Let's sync after canary results and re-evaluate the enforcement toggle once we have data.
